#!name=咪咕视频
#!desc=fmz200/wool_scripts · 某些APP要清除缓存或者重新安装拦截广告才会生效！
#!author=奶思

[MITM]
hostname = ggc.miguvideo.com, public-deliver9.miguvideo.com, display*-sc.miguvideo.com, recommend-dy.miguvideo.com, app-sc.miguvideo.com, common-sc.miguvideo.com, ggx*.miguvideo.com, ggic*.miguvideo.com

[Rewrite]
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/ggc\.miguvideo\.com\/v1\/iflyad\/deliverysystem\/direct\//i then reject_img(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/public-deliver9\.miguvideo\.com\/deliver\/site\/batchMatch\/mergeSpot\/miguvideo\//i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/recommend-dy\.miguvideo\.com\/recommend-dynamic\/dataSource\/v1\/recommend\/merge/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/app-sc\.miguvideo\.com\/app-management\/v1\/staticcache\/settings\/miguvideo\/SHARE_PIC/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/common-sc\.miguvideo\.com\/videoActivity\/activityList\//i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/ggx.+\.miguvideo\.com\/request\/sdk.+[^?]*$/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/ggic\d+.miguvideo\.com\/ad\//i then reject_dict(200)

[Script]
response if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/display-sc\.miguvideo\.com\/display\/v3\/static\/PERSONAL_CENTER$/i then script("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fmz200/wool_scripts/refs/heads/main/Scripts/miguvideo/miguvideo_ads.js") with tag="咪咕视频个人中心去广告", timeout=60, requires_body=true
